editorial.thesis: A hospitality-and-office-led city of about 895,000. Its retail is heavy on apparel, footwear & jewellery and pharmacy & health retail, and thin on banks & atms and fitness & wellness — and 48% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is ahead of Thiruvananthapuram. 22.56 chain outlets per lakh residents against 13.03 in Thiruvananthapuram; 36 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Reliance Trends 20, Bata 17, Reliance Smart / Fresh 15.

The mapped economy leans to malls & department stores. Shares of all mapped places: malls & department stores 0.6% (Thiruvananthapuram 0.4%); hotels & stays 6.6% (Thiruvananthapuram 4.6%); education 7.3% (Thiruvananthapuram 9.9%); leisure & entertainment 3.2% (Thiruvananthapuram 4.0%). Raw counts would mislead because Thiruvananthapuram is mapped less completely (19,850 places against 24,153), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 8 zones hold 48% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Hill Palace Road · Vaikom Road alone has about 61,000 residents and 32 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Thiruvananthapuram. 54% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Thiruvananthapuram 48%). The largest cores are Banerji Road · Azad Road (820 places) and Subhash Chandra Bose Road · Sa Road (691).

The widest brand gaps against Thiruvananthapuram. Bata 17 outlets vs 24; Titan 7 outlets vs 11; Big Bazaar 2 outlets vs 5. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 10 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Thiruvananthapuram, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Hill Palace Road · Vaikom Road and Kp Vallon Road · Sahodaran Ayyappan Road are the largest zones by residents (61,000 and 58,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 54% of all commercial places, and Banerji Road · Azad Road alone lists 820.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. MG Road · Mahatma Gandhi Road holds 17 of the 202 tracked chain outlets, and Subhash Chandra Bose Road · Sa Road adds 15.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Banerji Road · Azad Road and Srm Road · Banerji Road lead on education places (162 and 106, with 73 and 33 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Hill Palace Road · Vaikom Road and Kp Vallon Road · Sahodaran Ayyappan Road. The blue cores include Banerji Road · Azad Road.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (19,850 places in Thiruvananthapuram against 24,153 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Thiruvananthapuram; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi's mapped places over-index on malls & department stores (0.6% vs 0.4%), hotels & stays (6.6% vs 4.6%), offices (13.8% vs 10.9%) and under-index on education (7.3% vs 9.9%), leisure & entertainment (3.2% vs 4.0%), automotive (3.1% vs 3.8%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 202 outlets of 36 tracked national brands within 10 km — 22.56 per lakh residents against Thiruvananthapuram's 13.03 (176 outlets of 28 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Thiruvananthapuram are Bata (17 vs 24); Titan (7 vs 11); Big Bazaar (2 vs 5). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Thiruvananthapuram's, so low means thin by Thiruvananthapuram's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 10 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Kochi's age mix against Thiruvananthapuram: children (0–14) 19.0% vs 19.1%, 15–24 14.2% vs 15.8%, working age 53.1% vs 52.1%, 60+ 13.8% vs 13.0%. Under-25s are 33% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.3% of mapped places against 5.3% in Thiruvananthapuram, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 14 (Thiruvananthapuram 13), KFC 13 (Thiruvananthapuram 12), Pizza Hut 11 (Thiruvananthapuram 10), Subway 10 (Thiruvananthapuram 8). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.3% of mapped places against 2.2% in Thiruvananthapuram, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 9 (Thiruvananthapuram 6), Starbucks 4 (Thiruvananthapuram 3), Third Wave Coffee 1 (Thiruvananthapuram 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Sutta Bar, Chai Point, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.5% of mapped places against 0.5% in Thiruvananthapuram — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 11 (Thiruvananthapuram 12), Naturals 1 (Thiruvananthapuram 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 4.0% of mapped places against 4.6% in Thiruvananthapuram — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 15 (Thiruvananthapuram 5), DMart 4 (Thiruvananthapuram 2), Spencer's 4 (Thiruvananthapuram 5), More 3 (Thiruvananthapuram 5). No mapped outlet in either city: Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.1% of mapped places against 0.9% in Thiruvananthapuram — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 11 (Thiruvananthapuram 7), MedPlus 2 (Thiruvananthapuram 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 5.3% of mapped places against 4.1% in Thiruvananthapuram — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 20 (Thiruvananthapuram 19), Bata 17 (Thiruvananthapuram 24), Titan 7 (Thiruvananthapuram 11), Raymond 6 (Thiruvananthapuram 6).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 5.7% of mapped places against 6.8% in Thiruvananthapuram — below its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 2.3% of mapped places against 2.0% in Thiruvananthapuram — above its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 2.7% of mapped places against 3.2% in Thiruvananthapuram — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
